issue_context.title: [TaintBasedEvictions] Clean up featuregate logic
issue_context.body:
As part of moving TaintBasedEvictions to GA in 1.18 (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/87161), we need to clean up the logic around featuregating for this feature. Since it will be GA, it should not require a featuregate anymore.

/kind cleanup
/sig scheduling
comments: Does this issue need help? I can do this, if help is needed, please just assign it to me. THX~

Sure, thank you for offering to help

/assign @skilxn-go

Hi @damemi , I have a little question about it.
What's the expectation of this feature gate? Do we just move this feature gate to GA, or totally remove this feature gate?
And if we just move this feature to GA, do we need to Lock it to true?
So I send a pr with minimum modify. If there is anything wrong, please let me know, and I will fix it ASAP.

review_comments: Can you also remove its definition in type `Controller`?
